text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its most common uses is automation, which handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more complex and creative work. In addition, AI-powered productivity tools can analyze large amounts of information in seconds, helping teams make better decisions faster. However, the goal is not to replace humans but to collaborate with them. For instance, a doctor might use AI to review scans, while still making the final diagnosis. While some jobs will change or disappear, new roles are emerging in AI management and oversight. Therefore, adapting to these tools is becoming essential for career growth.
